qa_pairs.question: What modules are required to run GROMACS version 2016.5 on CPUs within the `StdEnv/2016.4` environment?
qa_pairs.answer: To run GROMACS version 2016.5 on CPUs in the `StdEnv/2016.4` environment, you need to load `StdEnv/2016.4`, `gcc/6.4.0`, `openmpi/2.1.1`, and `gromacs/2016.5`.

qa_pairs.question: How do I enable GPU acceleration for GROMACS version 5.1.5 when using the `StdEnv/2016.4` environment?
qa_pairs.answer: To use GROMACS version 5.1.5 with GPU acceleration (CUDA) in the `StdEnv/2016.4` environment, you should load the modules `StdEnv/2016.4`, `cuda/8.0.44`, and `gromacs/5.1.5`.

qa_pairs.question: What are some of the compiler and library configurations used for different GROMACS versions available under `StdEnv/2016.4`?
qa_pairs.answer: For GROMACS versions available in `StdEnv/2016.4`, configurations include 'GCC & FFTW' (e.g., `gromacs/2016.5`), 'Intel & MKL' (e.g., `gromacs/2016.3`, `gromacs/5.1.5`), and 'GCC & MKL & ThreadMPI' (for one of the `gromacs/4.6.7` entries).
